svg.title: Issue 3 — Page 1 — Panel 1: EST through-window — Cribbage's clockmaker shop, Clerkenwell, dawn
svg.desc: EST 28mm wide eye level. Looking through the shop window from the street. Reversed gold-leaf HOROLOGY across top of plate glass. Inside: Cribbage at main workbench (loupe to eye, absorbed) and Theodore in dim back corner sweeping. Grey morning daylight outside vs warm amber gaslight inside at the window-glass boundary. Painterly oil texture. Three days after the falling star.
svg.text: Three days after the falling star.
